# shopify_market (Resource)

A region market. Optional attributes left unset are not managed. Import with the market `handle`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shopify_market" "dach" {
  handle  = "dach"
  name    = "DACH"
  enabled = true

  conditions = {
    regions = ["DE", "AT", "CH"]
  }

  currency_settings = {
    base_currency    = "EUR"
    local_currencies = false
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `conditions` (Attributes) Which buyers the market applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `handle` (String) Market handle, unique per shop.
- `name` (String) Market name.

### Optional

- `catalog_ids` (Set of String) GIDs of linked catalogs.
- `currency_settings` (Attributes) Currency settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--currency_settings))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the market is active (`status = ACTIVE`) or a draft.
- `web_presence_ids` (Set of String) GIDs of linked web presences.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Market GID.

<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Required:

- `regions` (Set of String) Two-letter country codes. A country may be in several markets, but two active markets can't have the same set.


<a id="nestedatt--currency_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `currency_settings`

Optional:

- `base_currency` (String) Base currency code, e.g. `EUR`.
- `local_currencies` (Boolean) Whether buyers see prices in their local currency.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <handle>
terraform import shopify_market.dach dach
```
